title: The band folds in Cincinnati; back to Wiley College
summary: After the Kirk band's breakup in Cincinnati, Tate returns to Wiley and Nat Towles takes over the college band.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: So she brought the whole band to New York. We came to New York with her and we ended up in Buffalo at a place called the Vendome and you know, the bottom started falling out of the band. So when we got back to Cincinnati, it was five bands in the hotel, Delton Syncopaters, Speed Webb -- I

don't know if Roy was with them or not. I can't remember. Zack White, that was one of the Midwest name bands. We were all at the hotel and the band broke up and that's when I left to go back to -- I had this chance to go back -- this was around '35 -- to come back, they wanted me to come down to Wylie and be with the Wylie Collegians.

So I called my mother and told her I thought I would leave the band, you know. So I went back there and joined that band and that's where I stayed until Nat Toles took the band over in the latter part of '35, maybe early '36.
